groups.problem: The team admin-or-owner permission check uses && instead of ||, denying eligible team admins.
groups.rationale: All five suggestions identify the same boolean operator in the same authorization check. Differences in their descriptions of role semantics do not change the reported problem.

groups.problem: Passing raw guests instead of uniqueGuests to sendAddGuestsEmails misclassifies existing attendees as newly added guests.
groups.rationale: All five suggestions report the same incorrect argument at the email-sending call. Passing the actual added-guest list resolves each report.

groups.problem: Comparing raw guest addresses against a lowercased blacklist allows case-based blacklist bypasses.
groups.rationale: Both suggestions identify the same unnormalized blacklist comparison. S4 mentions attendee deduplication only as an additional proposed normalization change.

problems: Case-sensitive attendee authorization can reject a legitimate attendee whose session email has different casing.
Case-sensitive comparison against existing attendees allows an address differing only by case to be added again.
